item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00453","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C09","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters answer proposals about current economic weakness, acknowledge localized hardship, describe existing and continuing federal measures, emphasize the overall health and growth capacity of the economy, and warn that public confidence must be preserved by responsible leaders. The close correspondence in argument, sequence, and language—especially the paired treatment of hardship, continuing Administration action, economic growth, public confidence, and leadership responsibility—is materially stronger than shared topic alone. C09 contains related confidence-centered economic rhetoric, while C15 has a loosely parallel response-to-a-governor structure, but neither matches the child as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the hardships brought by the falling off of business to many families through shortened work weeks and temporary unemployment are of the deepest concern to me and to the Administration","parent_excerpt":"I am well aware of those areas presently experiencing certain economic hardships during this transitional period.","explanation":"Both acknowledge current, localized economic hardship before turning to the Administration's broader response."},{"child_excerpt":"many steps have already been taken by the federal government that bear on the situation ... Other measures are under Administrative consideration","parent_excerpt":"we have taken and will continue to take bold steps ... Continuing steps have been and are constantly being taken to re-examine the policies of the Federal Government affecting economic growth and stability.","explanation":"The child closely adapts the parent's past-and-continuing-action formulation."},{"child_excerpt":"I believe that the underlying growth factors in the economy remain vigorous and every indication is that they will reassert themselves later in the year.","parent_excerpt":"the most important attack on these situations is from the standpoint of fostering the over-all health and vitality of our economy ... favorable to sustained economic growth.","explanation":"Both frame recovery through the economy's overall vitality and sustained growth rather than isolated remedies."},{"child_excerpt":"all of us in positions of trust and authority have a great responsibility in these times ... to strengthen, and not weaken, a tough-minded confidence in the future.","parent_excerpt":"All of our citizens in positions of leadership have the responsibility ... to maintain a steady, unshakable attitude of public confidence in the capacity of the American economy for continued growth.","explanation":"This is a distinctive shared rhetorical construction linking leadership responsibility, public confidence, and future economic growth."}]}
